home.title: AWS Lambda backends, with conventions baked in.
home.subtitle: sawsi is a Python framework for serverless backends on AWS — `cmd`-based routing, a DynamoDB ORM, lazy-loaded service wrappers, and a deployment story that scales from one Lambda to a fleet.

handlers.title: Handlers & Routing
handlers.desc: @aws_handler_wrapper auto-formats responses; router() dispatches to @controller functions via signature-based injection.

dynamo.title: DynamoModel ORM
dynamo.desc: Pydantic-typed models with auto fields (id, crt, u_b), GSI declaration, sparse-index support, and per-attribute update tracking.

services.title: AWS Service Wrappers
services.desc: S3, SQS, SES, SMS, Locking, Firehose, SecretsManager, Bedrock, OpenSearch, Vector KB — all behind a uniform api.py singleton.

triggers.title: Multi-trigger Lambdas
triggers.desc: awsi add -t {agw|sqs|ebs|ws|webhook} scaffolds API Gateway, SQS, EventBridge, WebSocket, or webhook receivers.

deploy.title: Container-image deploys
deploy.desc: Dockerfile + buildspec-{env}.yml drives CodeBuild → ECR → Lambda update; build_keeper.py initializes DynamoDB tables and indexes idempotently.

conventions.title: Conventions over config
conventions.desc: {env}-{project} resource naming, allowed_cmd_prefixes security gate, A/B/U response codes — the framework opinions the boring decisions.

newcomer.title: New to sawsi
newcomer.desc: Start with the 5-minute tour, then walk the mental model.

building.title: Building features
building.desc: Cookbook recipes for OAuth, SQS workers, schedulers, and more.

deploying.title: Shipping to AWS
deploying.desc: Container image deploy, IAM env scoping, and cold-start tuning.
